subject: Architecture
title: Passive Solar Design: Free Heating and Cooling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Passive Solar Design: Free Heating and Cooling.

hook.text: Ancient Romans oriented their bathhouses to catch afternoon sun. We forgot that trick for centuries.

buildup.text: Passive solar design positions windows, walls, and floors to collect, store, and distribute sun warmth.

discovery.text: South-facing windows in the Northern Hemisphere capture winter sun while roof overhangs block summer heat.

twist.text: Thermal mass — concrete or stone floors — absorbs heat during the day and releases it at night for free.

climax.text: Well-designed passive solar homes can reduce heating bills by 50-70% with zero mechanical systems.

punchline.text: The best heating system is a window pointed in the right direction.

quiz.question: How much can passive solar design reduce heating costs?
